generations.prompt: Photoreal, a kitchen at night, tall vertical frame, 35 mm, the camera locked off across the small table slightly below eye level; it does not move. The man of about forty-five sits alone, his face and hands lit only by the pale glow of the open laptop in front of him, his reading glasses pushed up on his head; he reads for a moment, then takes the glasses off, rubs his eyes slowly with finger and thumb, lets out a long breath, and looks away from the laptop toward the dark window, lips closed; he does not speak. A faint warm street light through the window; the crayon drawing on the fridge behind him. No on-screen text, no lettering anywhere; the laptop screen is out of frame.
